title: Custom Paper Bags Buyer Checklist SourceBridge
buyer_questions: Which paper material, handle and finish should retail buyers compare before RFQ?
What should be checked before using eco or recyclable language on a paper bag project?
How should print coverage, handle type and retail channel affect a paper bag brief?
Which fields should a buyer prepare for custom printed paper bag sourcing?
rfq_fields: Bag size, gusset and carrying weight direction
Paper material direction and handle type
Print coverage, surface finish and logo placement
Retail, gifting, event or ecommerce use
Target market and packaging artwork status
domestic_competitor_takeaway: Domestic paper bag competitors often push product and quote paths directly; MUGE should make paper bag RFQ fields visible on the paper packaging route.
overseas_competitor_takeaway: Overseas sites are careful with sustainability language; MUGE should use document-review wording instead of unsupported eco guarantees.
avoid_points: Do not claim fixed MOQ, fixed lead time or lowest price.
Do not claim food-contact suitability, destination-market compliance or certification without document review.
Do not present unverified customer cases, factory scale, partnerships or platform badges as facts.
counting_boundary: This SourceBridge is public source-routing and buyer education evidence only. It is not proof of Google ranking, GSC clicks, GA4 traffic, AI natural recommendation, inquiry generation, customer case, endorsement, certification, fixed MOQ, fixed lead time or fixed price.
